app.title: Verba
app.offline: No connection to the server. The app is offline — once the connection is back, this view resumes automatically.
app.closedNotice: Verba has been shut down. You can close this tab now.
app.networkError: Connection to the server was lost.
dashboard.title: Transcripts
dashboard.empty: No transcripts yet. Create one — each transcript gets its own workspace folder for audio, texts and exports.
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Do you really want to delete the transcript "{name}"? The associated files will be kept.
dashboard.setupHintTitle: System setup is not complete yet.
dashboard.setupHintText: Some components are missing — transcription becomes available after setup.
project.workspaceHint: Workspace: {path} — you can also drag & drop audio files or whole folders here.
project.noAudio: No supported audio files in the selection.
editor.noSelection: Drag on the waveform to select a section.
editor.editStarted: Audio edit started — the result appears as a new file in the transcript.
editor.noSegments: No segments yet — transcribe the file in the transcript view first.
editor.pdfHeaderRight: Place and date on the right
editor.pdfHeaderHint: Free text — e.g. just “2024-08-17” or “Munich, 28.01.1933”. A date written as YYYY-MM-DD is rendered as DD.MM.YYYY.
browser.title: Import from server
setup.title: First-run setup
setup.intro: Verba checks your system and installs missing components automatically. The first run can take a few minutes (background downloads).
search.title: Semantic search
settings.title: Settings
settings.modelHint: Name (e.g. small, large-v3) or a local model folder; subfolders of the models directory are detected.
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored locally in data/settings.json and never shown in clear text.
settings.portHint: Takes effect on the next start.
settings.logRetentionHint: Older logs are rotated and deleted automatically.
models.title: Model management (Whisper)
models.intro: Models are downloaded into the models directory and become selectable everywhere.
docs.title: Documentation
settings.docsHint: User guide covering all features, right inside the app.
ai.title: AI processing
ai.introFile: Cleanup and translation for this file — results appear as tabs below.
ai.introProject: Cleanup and translation for all transcribed files in this transcript.
ai.cleanup: Clean up transcript (filler words, punctuation, mishearings)
types.title: Transcript types
types.intro: Types steer the AI through two prompts: the cleanup prompt decides how the transcript is edited, the output-format prompt how the PDF is built from it. Builtin types can be adapted or deleted too; transcripts without a type give plain, unformatted text.
types.name: Name
types.promptHint: Instruction for the LLM on how transcripts of this type should be edited.
types.structureHint: Decides what the PDF export builds from and how it structures without AI: dialogue and script start from the segments with their speakers, everything else from the processed text.
types.promptOutputHint: Instruction for the LLM on how the processed text is split into blocks for the PDF export. Leaving it empty means the default prompt applies — it then shows as the field's placeholder. The cleanup prompt is added as context.
settings.aiIntro: Cleanup and translation need a language model. Pick one path — only one applies at a time.
settings.llmOffHint: Cleanup and translation are disabled — transcription and the editor work fully.
settings.llmLocalModelHint: Empty = Verba automatically picks the recommended installed model.
editor.noLlm: No language model configured — set one up in the settings.
types.select: Select a type from the list or create a new one with +.
system.intro: Information about the machine Verba is running on.
export.title: PDF export
export.introFile: Creates a PDF following the transcript type's template.
export.introProject: Creates one collective PDF of all transcribed files — sections follow each other separated by spacing only.
export.hint: With an LLM configured the AI structures the text to match the type; without one the export is rule-based. Without a type a plain text PDF is produced.
search.sources: Sources — click jumps into the editor at the position (audio starts there):
search.unavailableText: Semantic search needs the “Semantic search” feature group — install it via the setup.
settings.searchIntro: One global index across all transcripts. New transcriptions and segment edits are indexed automatically; deleted files disappear from the index immediately.
settings.embeddingModelHint: A fixed choice of multilingual, CPU-friendly models. A change automatically starts a full reindex.
settings.reindexHint: Runs as a background job with progress in the status monitor.
settings.apiIntro: OpenAI-compatible transcription API for external programs. As soon as at least one key exists, the endpoint requires “Authorization: Bearer <key>” — without any key it is open (suitable for strictly local use only).
settings.apiNoKeys: No keys yet — the API can be used without authentication.
settings.apiKeyCreated: New key — copy it now, it is shown only this once:
settings.apiDocsHint: Examples (curl, Python) are in the user guide under “Public API”.
docs.askIntro: The AI answers from this guide only. Every question starts fresh — this is not a chat.
docs.askPlaceholder: e.g. How do I export translations into one PDF?
docs.askEmpty: The language model returned no answer.
docs.answerFiltered: (The guide was pre-filtered for this question.)
setup.workspaceIntro: This is where Verba keeps one folder per transcript: the imported audio files, the transcript JSONs and the PDF exports. Absolute paths are explicitly fine, network drives included.
setup.workspaceContents: If you change the path later, existing transcript folders move along automatically.
setup.whisperIntro: Model, directory and device for speech recognition. Models inside the chosen directory are loaded straight from there — nothing is copied.
setup.modelsDirHint: Leave empty for the default directory. Models already present in the folder are detected automatically.
setup.llmIntro: Optional: for cleanup, translation, PDF structure, search answers and the questions about this guide. Transcription works exactly the same without one.
setup.llmLocalHint: Download the local model (llama.cpp) after the setup under Settings → AI — the recommendation for your hardware is shown there.
setup.searchIntro: The semantic search builds one index across all transcripts. The embedding model decides how well it finds across languages.
setup.searchReady: Search components are installed — the index is built automatically while transcribing.
setup.searchMissing: Search components are still missing — step 1 can install them.
settings.searchModelMismatch: The index was built with another model — please rebuild it.
settings.workspacesMoveHint: Saving a new path moves existing transcript folders there (background job).
settings.embeddingsDirHint: Leave empty for the default directory. If the model is already there (a copied folder or a moved HuggingFace cache), it is loaded from there instead of being downloaded again.
settings.llmModelsDirHint: Leave empty for the default directory. Every .gguf file in it becomes selectable and is loaded straight from there — nothing is copied.
models.fitHint: The rating is for this machine — these models run locally.
settings.endpointLocalGpu: This endpoint runs on this machine ({ram} GB RAM, {gpu}). Free right now: models up to about {vramBudget} GB on the GPU or {ramBudget} GB in RAM — an estimate only: Verba does not manage that server.
settings.endpointLocal: This endpoint runs on this machine ({ram} GB RAM, {gpu}). Free right now: models up to about {ramBudget} GB — an estimate only: Verba does not manage that server.
models.hardwareRam: This system: {ram} GB RAM — the search runs on the CPU.
